project-state.description: The BlueTEXT project has been refactored from a simple link portal into an interactive, VS Code-themed single-page app dashboard. All tools are loaded dynamically via search-index.json. Search filters items in real-time, and sidebars route tools instantly.

active-configurations.theme-style: VS Code Dark (#1e1e1e) and VS Code Light (#ffffff) themes mapped in themes.css. Borders are clean, status colors comply with accessibility baselines.
active-configurations.clear-cache-button: Moved from a trash icon to a red outline button labeled "Clear Cache" in the header component for clarity.
active-configurations.translations-coverage: Parsed elements expanded to span, li, h4, h5, h6 nodes, capturing 1910 terms across 20 languages successfully.

guardrail.title: Memory Integrity
guardrail.rule: Never overwrite or delete logs inside AIMemory.xml or AIMemory.md. Always append dated tags.

guardrail.title: Contrast Compliance
guardrail.rule: Keep text class color codes compliant with WCAG 2.1 AA (ratio >= 4.5:1). Check borders and inputs in themes.css.

guardrail.title: Layout Injection
guardrail.rule: All page headers and footers are compiled statically at build-time. Whenever header.html or footer.html is modified, you MUST run "node scripts/build.js" to inject changes across all 533 files.

guardrail.title: Client-Side Boundary
guardrail.rule: All tools must execute locally. Dictionaries must load from assets/data/i18n/ via fetch without server-side routing.

next-steps.step: Monitor client-side search indexing sizes if tool directories expand beyond 1000 items.
Observe local cache behavior during authentication state updates.
